rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something happens at last, especially after a delay or difficulty.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu4 wan2 dou2 fan6 gung1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the eventual outcome or for the last item or action, rather than the sense of relief in 終於.

example.english: We finally decided to take a taxi.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 hau6 kyut3 ding6 daap3 dik1 si6

rows.note: Use this when summing up what is ultimately true or what matters when everything is considered.

example.english: When you finally get down to it, what matters most is that everyone is happy.
example.traditional: 講到底，最重要係大家開心。
example.jyutping: gong2 dou3 dai2 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 hai6 daai6 gaa1 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this when “finally” means thoroughly or definitively, as in settling an issue once and for all, not merely at the end of a sequence.

example.english: We need to finally resolve this issue once and for all.
example.traditional: 我哋今次一定要徹底解決呢個問題。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 jat1 ding6 jiu3 cit3 dai2 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4
